text:
maria: Quick heads-up — after shipping http2 connection pooling in the node + python SDKs, we see intermittent "unattributed" tokens in Console. started ~09:10 UTC during the SDK canary.

derek: I pulled proxy traces. ingress header X-Route-Policy present, but downstream optimizer sometimes sees empty string. frequency ~5-10%.

olivia: any pattern? only h2? only long-lived connections?

maria: looks correlated with long-lived h2 streams + large request bursts. hypothesis: HPACK table eviction + our proxy header-normalizer ends up reusing a stale header index that resolves to empty.

henry: interesting — we added a header dedupe/normalize fast-path in proxy that caches header indexes for performance. if HPACK evicts an entry, index reuse could map wrong.

derek: reproduce: run node-sdk with keepAlive on a single connection, flood 1000 small requests, check what optimizer sees. I can send a repro script.

maria: we should decide mitigations: rollback SDK h2 pooling, hotfix proxy to disable header-index caching, or make SDK duplicate header under a safe name (X-Route-Policy-Alt) as fallback.

support-bot: support has 3 paying customers with quota blips. finance notified. customers are unhappy.

olivia: rollback SDK is heavy — customers may already have the canary. Proxy hotfix is fastest: turn off header-index caching and fallback to full header parse when route header absent. low-risk config flip.

henry: agree. i can flip the config and restart pools in canary zone in ~20m. also add a guard in parser to detect empty values and force reparse.

ci-bot: test gap: no integration tests exercise HPACK eviction + proxy cache mode. adding a targeted test to the suite.

derek: while we patch proxy, let's also plan an SDK follow-up: opt-in flag keepAliveHeaderWorkaround that will send X-Route-Policy and X-Route-Policy-Alt with same value. owners: maria(node), rachel(py). opt-in first release.

maria: opening PR for proxy config flip now. will monitor Console attribution metrics.

[25m later]

henry: canary applied, header-index caching disabled on proxy-pool-canary. attributed tokens returned to baseline within one sampling window.

olivia: nice. follow-ups: 1) postmortem on header-index cache correctness (henry) 2) CI integration test for HPACK eviction scenarios (ci-bot) 3) SDK opt-in duplicate header support + docs (maria/rachel) 4) Console telemetry tile for "route_header_missing_after_proxy" sampled events (product/console).

maria: will lead SDK opt-in and coordinate small release notes. plan: opt-in env var then default-on after 2 minor releases if safe.

ops-bot: incident INC-2026-0462 created and linked to PRs.

derek: thanks team. quick triage and low-risk fix. archive once postmortem and tests are done. :thumbsup:
